value.content:
# situation: on push, the job downloads with
#   dawidd6/action-download-artifact v3, whose step has no input run_id, the
#   artifact named out, from the newest run of its own workflow into the
#   workspace, and then runs build.sh with bash.
# reason: with no input run_id, the version v3 takes the newest successful
#   run of the workflow, the run of a pull request from a fork too, whatever
#   event the job runs on: the search does not filter the runs by the event
#   of the job.
# attack-value: the file build.sh in the artifact named out, from the fork's pull_request run of the workflow = "echo PWNED\n"
# attack-run-behavior: the pull request from a fork changes the workflow to
#   run on pull_request too, and the pull_request run uploads build.sh in
#   the artifact named out; the next push run takes that run, the newest
#   successful one, and bash build.sh prints PWNED in a job that has the
#   base repository's secrets and a token of actions: read.
on: workflow_call
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: out
      - run: bash build.sh
